reason: The primary CIF is parseable and symmetry-expands in primitive P-1 to the claimed fully occupied Z=1 cell (a=4.5827, b=4.4291, c=6.3644 A; alpha=89.839, beta=92.679, gamma=90.427 degrees; 3 Ca, 1 Co, 6 O, 10 atoms), but the instantiated atomic realization is not established by the diffraction evidence. Indexing covered only 22 of the 26 selected lines, and the separately supplied comparable-profile report has no score. More decisively, the trace's own integrated-intensity calculation for the final coordinates predicts important intensity where the observation is essentially zero (obs/calc 0/4.33 at 13.919 degrees, 0/17.91 at 40.701 degrees, 0/10.45 at 46.120 degrees, and 0/8.47 at 46.425 degrees) while missing major observed intensity (38.43/5.01 at 47.648 degrees and 11.89/1.00 at 52.510 degrees). An independent broadening/scale/background fit of this CIF to the blind profile likewise gives a 46.5% unweighted normalized profile residual, rising to 71.4% over 40-60 degrees, so peak-position agreement cannot rescue the coordinate model. Chemistry also fails as a supporting check: the periodic shell has six Co-O distances of 2.439-2.449 A despite charge balance requiring Co(+6), several O-O contacts of 1.954-1.977 A, Ca-O contacts down to 1.939 A, and automated bond-valence assignment fails. The trace shows multiple materially different coordinate minima rather than convergence and submitted none of its alternatives. Another structure-solution attempt is therefore likely to produce a materially different viable realization; no single specific surviving branch is sufficiently instantiated to name.
